title: kitfox-config namespace
description: Validates clusters/{cluster}/namespaces/{ns}/namespace.yaml — the CreateNamespaceParameters surface (§2.6, §2.6b, Story A.2). additionalProperties:false rejects removed flags (consortia/isConsortiaSingleUi/hasSecureTenant/linkedData/loadReference/loadSample) and edge config.

platform.description: Platform this namespace runs (§2.6, corrections #3/#4). Owned at the namespace level.

platformBranch.description: Eureka: platform-lsp branch driving versions via FAR (§2.6).

folioBranch.description: Okapi-only platform branch, accommodated for the Okapi pass (§7, Epic E).

lifecycle.description: Namespace category + protection (§2.6; replaces the Constants.groovy category arrays §2c).

members.description: GitHub team names (+ pseudo tokens) for Rancher RBAC (§2.6).

infra.description: Topology OVERRIDE — built-in|aws flags only, never coordinates (§2.6, §0, NFR7).

features.description: Boolean feature flags (§2.6). additionalProperties:false rejects the removed flags (consortia/isConsortiaSingleUi/hasSecureTenant/linkedData/loadReference/loadSample/dataset) — correction #2.

configExtensions.description: Feature overlays applied in list order; each maps to platform/feature-overlays/<name>.yaml (§2.2b, §2.6).

consortia.description: Consortium membership; required when a consortia-central tenant is present (§2.6). Cross-level presence/consistency enforced by Epic D (D.4).

applications.description: Namespace-wide application exclusions (§2.6). Exclude-only; there is no include pool.

tenants.description: Tenant membership by catalog id (§2.6). Mutually exclusive with dataset (enforced by D.5).

defaultTenant.description: Default tenant id; must be in tenants[] (cross-level check D.2).

dataset.description: Dataset restore (§2.6, correction #8). Mutually exclusive with explicit tenants[] (enforced by D.5).

operations.description: Operational MODIFIER defaults only (§5.3, NFR4). Run-control SELECTORS (type/namespaceOnly/dmSnapshot) are pipeline-only and rejected by additionalProperties:false.

podPlacement.description: Namespace-wide pod placement (§2.6; replaces the quality-gate nodeSelector/tolerations branch).

modules.description: Per-module config overrides for this namespace (§2.6, §2.6b).
